title: make test fails at base: TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo gets exit 1 (gate config read) where it wants exit 2 (no executor configured)
body: internal/cli's TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo builds the binary and runs `ticfac run-epic x`; the run exits 1 with 'read the gate configuration: open <cwd>/.tick/runners.toml: no such file or directory' before it can reach the expected 'no executor configured' (exit 2). Reproduced at base 444e96be with this tick's changes stashed, so it is not sj2's, but it makes the full Go suite a red signal on this host and the order of the two failures in run-epic's startup is worth a look.
